source_standard: Full creator pages must be rebuilt from downloaded video transcripts, not caption-only notes or 8-post curation files.

dossiers.title: Potential is invisible until the voice is recognized
dossiers.summary: People are bad at recognizing potential early, so the creator has to protect and train their own voice before external evidence arrives.

dossiers.title: Distance is neutral; capacity is the variable
dossiers.summary: The gap between present and future is less important than strengthening the person doing the walking.

dossiers.title: Reading as active extraction
dossiers.summary: Memory improves when reading begins with the assumption that something useful is inside and a plan to retrieve it.

dossiers.title: Eric Berne and hidden relational scripts
dossiers.summary: Games People Play becomes a lens for noticing parent/adult/child roles and the scripts people unconsciously replay.

dossiers.title: The trap of accusation games
dossiers.summary: The NIGYSOB game shows how people bait each other into confirmation, grievance, and control.

dossiers.title: Responsibility games and displaced blame
dossiers.summary: The See What You Made Me Do pattern reveals how one person can outsource responsibility for their own actions.

dossiers.title: Let the child loose
dossiers.summary: Authentic creative energy comes from recovering the playful, experimental child without abandoning adult discipline.

dossiers.title: Aman and the power of staying small
dossiers.summary: Adrian Zecha makes hospitality feel sacred by refusing generic luxury scale and protecting intimacy.

dossiers.title: Potential trinity for high performers
dossiers.summary: Potential becomes usable when identity, performance, and lived capacity line up instead of staying abstract.

dossiers.title: Beams and the excitement of basic
dossiers.summary: Beams turns ordinary retail into a culture machine through sub-brands, curation, and Japanese specificity.

dossiers.title: Gentle Monster and newness as moat
dossiers.summary: The eyewear brand treats stores as art installations, making novelty a repeatable experience rather than a seasonal trick.

dossiers.title: HeyTea and product invention
dossiers.summary: Cheese foam becomes a category-making idea because the brand uses product format, not just campaign language, to change behavior.

dossiers.title: Arc teryx and detail obsession
dossiers.summary: Technical details, refusal of convention, and mountain-use truth become the brand promise.

dossiers.title: Nishiyama Onsen Keiunkan and time horizon
dossiers.summary: A 1300-year hotel reframes brand endurance as stewardship across generations, not quarterly growth.

dossiers.title: Nothing and transparent clarity
dossiers.summary: Carl Pei positions hardware through visible design logic, community energy, and the dream of making tech exciting again.

dossiers.title: Chrome Hearts as anti-scale system
dossiers.summary: Anti-fashion, vertical integration, family continuity, and refusal of ecommerce turn founder conviction into infrastructure.

dossiers.title: Ralph Lauren and life as worldbuilding
dossiers.summary: Ralph Lauren builds a movie-set universe where the founder belief becomes a coherent emotional environment.

dossiers.title: Luckin vs Starbucks as market-fit test
dossiers.summary: Luckin succeeds by matching Chinese consumer behavior through mobile ordering, pickup speed, and product cadence.

dossiers.title: Laopu Gold and Chinese luxury confidence
dossiers.summary: Laopu Gold suggests luxury can be built from Chinese craft codes instead of Western validation.

dossiers.title: Onitsuka Tiger and determined reinvention
dossiers.summary: The Asics lineage becomes fashionable again by holding onto performance principles while sharpening cultural presentation.

dossiers.title: To Summer and non-Western fragrance luxury
dossiers.summary: Shen Li frames fragrance through Chinese seasonal, poetic, and material traditions rather than European aristocratic perfume logic.

dossiers.title: Brand-maxing against synthetic sameness
dossiers.summary: In a world of AI-flattened taste, brands need a full-send point of view, dense worlds, and prolific specificity.

dossiers.title: Agentic branding
dossiers.summary: AI agents can parse metadata and consensus, but they cannot feel aura, taste, or emotional conviction the way humans do.

dossiers.title: Snow Peak and fun as operating principle
dossiers.summary: Outdoor products become community infrastructure when the brand treats fun and use as a founder-level commitment.

dossiers.title: Rocky s Matcha and constraint entrepreneurship
dossiers.summary: A founder with a 9-to-5 shows how strong product taste, internet fluency, and constraint can still build momentum.

dossiers.title: NPR and civic brand memory
dossiers.summary: The campaign works by using familiar legacy cues to clarify a side, a moral orientation, and a reason to trust.

dossiers.title: Project Hail Mary and difficult worldbuilding
dossiers.summary: The craft lesson is that worlds feel real when makers choose the hard path, even in details viewers may not consciously notice.

dossiers.title: Malbon and the Instagram moodboard brand
dossiers.summary: Golf becomes culturally refreshed through image logic, casualness, and a moodboard that understands younger leisure codes.

dossiers.title: Krave Beauty and refusal to launch
dossiers.summary: The skincare brand uses restraint, sustainability, and product discipline as its differentiation against launch addiction.

dossiers.title: Weekly brand scan: cognitive gummies
dossiers.summary: Small category experiments reveal how wellness, taste, and performance branding keep merging into snackable formats.

dossiers.title: Daymaker and cakes as sales infrastructure
dossiers.summary: Cake delivery becomes more than novelty when it replaces cold outreach with a warmer relationship ritual.

dossiers.title: Nonfiction and Korean lifestyle fragrance
dossiers.summary: The brand turns scent into spatial, editorial, and flagship experience rather than just another cosmetics SKU.

dossiers.title: Din Tai Fung and quality as proof
dossiers.summary: Exact dumpling folds, open kitchens, and slow growth make operational quality visible to the customer.

dossiers.title: With Raw Materials and material imagination
dossiers.summary: Stella Lee treats algae yarn, mushrooms, fish skin, and manufacturing experiments as the center of product design.

dossiers.title: Savannah Bananas and participatory sports
dossiers.summary: The team reinvents baseball by designing entertainment rules, audience delight, and scarcity before marketing spend.

dossiers.title: Ceiling Service and third-space repair
dossiers.summary: The Seoul audio-visual concept points toward venues that make rest, sound, and gathering feel intentionally designed.

dossiers.title: Stone Island and archive as engine
dossiers.summary: Material research, garment dyeing, and archive discipline make experimentation cumulative instead of random.

dossiers.title: In-flight magazines as analog brand worlds
dossiers.summary: Airline magazines show how owned media can turn travel brands into cultural curators and attention sanctuaries.

editorial_reading.core_contribution: Brand as trained conviction under optimization pressure.
editorial_reading.editorial_standard: Use the detailed transcript as proof; avoid auto-generated filler and fake reference imagery.
